entities.name: Ekbert von Andechs-Meranien
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ekbert of Andechs-Meranien was Prince-Bishop of Bamberg, Germany from 1203 until his death. He was the son of Berthold IV, Duke of Merania and Agnes of Rochlitz, and a brother of Saint Hedwig of Silesia and Gertrude of Merania, Queen of Hungary.
